# LeadPilot AI CRM — User Guide

## Workspace Features

- **Leads & Deals:** Drag-and-drop Kanban deal pipeline with AI propensity scoring.
- **Omnichannel Hub:** Send WhatsApp, Email, and SMS messages directly with timeline history.
- **Intelligent Documents:** Upload contract files with SHA-256 integrity and AI OCR processing.
- **AI Workspace Copilot:** Ask complex multi-domain queries with citations.
